Title: Register a new customer with all mandatory details
Test data: Name: Priya Shah; Email: unique, e.g. priya.shah+<timestamp>@example.com; Password: Secret#123; Country: Canada
Steps:
1. Open the home page and click "Signup / Login".
2. Under "New User Signup!" enter name and email, click "Signup".
3. Check "ENTER ACCOUNT INFORMATION" is shown with name and email pre-filled.
4. Fill title, password, date of birth, first/last name, address, country, state, city, zipcode and mobile number.
5. Click "Create Account".
6. Click "Continue".
Expected result: "ACCOUNT CREATED!" is shown. After Continue the header reads "Logged in as Priya Shah".
Actual result: "ACCOUNT CREATED!" shown; header "Logged in as Priya Shah".

Title: Signup is refused for an email that is already registered
Preconditions: An account exists for the email used.
Steps:
1. Go to "Signup / Login".
2. Enter any name and the existing email under "New User Signup!".
3. Click "Signup".
Expected result: Stays on the page with the message "Email Address already exist!". No second account is created.
Actual result: "Email Address already exist!" shown, stayed on signup.

Title: Signup email must be a valid address
Steps:
1. Go to "Signup / Login".
2. Enter a name and each invalid email in turn.
3. Click "Signup".
Expected result: Form is not submitted; the browser flags the email field as invalid.
Actual result: All three invalid emails blocked by browser validation.

Title: Account information form enforces mandatory fields
Preconditions: On "ENTER ACCOUNT INFORMATION" after step 2 of UI-AUTH-01.
Test data: Leave password, first name, last name, address, state, city, zipcode, mobile empty one at a time
Steps:
1. Leave one mandatory field empty and fill the rest.
2. Click "Create Account".
3. Repeat for each mandatory field.
Expected result: Account is not created while any mandatory field is empty; the empty field is highlighted.
Actual result: Not created with any mandatory field empty (8/8 flagged by validation).

Title: Log in with a valid email and password
Steps:
1. Go to "Signup / Login".
2. Enter email and password under "Login to your account".
3. Click "Login".
Expected result: Home page opens and the header shows "Logged in as <name>", plus "Logout" and "Delete Account" links.
Actual result: Logged in; Logout and Delete Account links shown.

Title: Login is refused with a wrong password
Steps:
1. Enter the email and a wrong password.
2. Click "Login".
Expected result: "Your email or password is incorrect!" is shown and the user stays logged out.
Actual result: "Your email or password is incorrect!" shown, user stays logged out. (First attempt hit a page-load timeout on the shared site; re-run passed.)

Title: Unknown email gets the same message as a wrong password
Steps:
1. Enter an email that has never been registered and any password.
2. Click "Login".
Expected result: Same generic message as UI-AUTH-06, so the page does not reveal which emails are registered.
Actual result: Same generic message as for a wrong password.

Title: Logout ends the session
Steps:
1. Click "Logout".
2. Press the browser Back button.
3. Reload the page.
Expected result: Login page opens. Going back and reloading does not show "Logged in as".
Actual result: Redirected to login; Back + reload did not restore the session.

Title: Delete account removes access
Preconditions: Logged in with a throwaway account.
Steps:
1. Click "Delete Account".
2. Click "Continue".
3. Try to log in with the same credentials.
Expected result: "ACCOUNT DELETED!" is shown; logging in again fails with the incorrect-credentials message.
Actual result: "ACCOUNT DELETED!" shown; logging in again refused.

Title: Password is masked and never appears in the URL
Steps:
1. Type a password in the login form.
2. Submit and look at the address bar and browser history.
Expected result: Characters are masked while typing; the password is not part of any URL.
Actual result: Field type=password; password not in URL after submit.

Title: All Products page lists the catalogue
Steps: 1. Click "Products" in the header.
Expected result: "ALL PRODUCTS" heading with product cards, each showing image, name, price, "Add to cart" and "View Product".
Actual result: "ALL PRODUCTS" with 34 product cards; image, name, price, Add to cart, View Product present.

Title: Product detail page shows full product information
Steps: 1. On All Products click "View Product" for the first item.
Expected result: Detail page shows name, category, price, availability, condition and brand.
Actual result: Name, category, price, availability, condition and brand shown.

Title: Search returns matching products only
Steps:
1. On All Products type the keyword in "Search Product".
2. Click the search button.
Expected result: "SEARCHED PRODUCTS" heading; every result contains the keyword in its name or category.
Actual result: "SEARCHED PRODUCTS" with 3 results: Soft Stretch Jeans, Regular Fit Straight Jeans, Grunt Blue Slim Fit Jeans.

Title: Search with no matches shows an empty result
Steps: 1. Search for a keyword that matches nothing.
Expected result: No product cards and no error page. (A helpful "no results" message is expected; record what is actually shown.)
Actual result: No product cards and no error. Only the "SEARCHED PRODUCTS" heading is shown, with no "no results" message (usability note).

Title: Search ignores letter case
Steps: 1. Search for each variant.
Expected result: Same results for every variant.
Actual result: Same 14 results for top / TOP / ToP.

Title: Filter by category
Steps:
1. In the left sidebar expand "Women" and click "Dress".
2. Then expand "Men" and click "Tshirts".
Expected result: Headings "WOMEN - DRESS PRODUCTS" and "MEN - TSHIRTS PRODUCTS"; only products from that category are listed.
Actual result: "WOMEN - DRESS PRODUCTS" and "MEN - TSHIRTS PRODUCTS" shown.

Title: Filter by brand and check the product count
Steps:
1. Click a brand under "Brands".
2. Count the products shown and compare with the number next to the brand.
Expected result: "BRAND - POLO PRODUCTS" heading; number of cards equals the count in brackets in the sidebar.
Actual result: Polo: sidebar 6, shown 6; H&M: sidebar 5, shown 5.

Title: Write a product review
Steps:
1. Fill "Your Name", "Email Address" and "Add Review Here!".
2. Click "Submit".
Expected result: "Thank you for your review." is shown and the form is cleared.
Actual result: "Thank you for your review." shown.

Title: Review cannot be submitted with empty fields
Steps: 1. Leave one field empty at a time and click "Submit".
Expected result: Review is not submitted; the empty field is flagged.
Actual result: Not submitted with any field empty (3/3 flagged).

Title: Add to cart from "Recommended Items"
Steps:
1. Scroll to "RECOMMENDED ITEMS" at the bottom of the home page.
2. Click "Add to cart" on a product.
3. Click "View Cart".
Expected result: The recommended product is in the cart.
Actual result: "Stylish Dress" from Recommended Items is in the cart.

Title: Add two products and check the cart lines
Steps:
1. On All Products hover the first product and click "Add to cart", then "Continue Shopping".
2. Add the second product and click "View Cart".
Expected result: Both products listed with correct name, price, quantity 1 and line total.
Actual result: Blue Top Rs. 500 ×1; Men Tshirt Rs. 400 ×1.

Title: Quantity chosen on the detail page is kept
Steps:
1. Open a product detail page.
2. Set quantity to 4 and click "Add to cart".
3. Click "View Cart".
Expected result: Cart shows quantity 4 and total = price × 4.
Actual result: Quantity 4, total Rs. 2000.

Title: Quantity field boundaries on the detail page
Steps:
1. Enter each value in Quantity and click "Add to cart".
2. Check the cart after each attempt.
Expected result: 1 and 999 are accepted. 0, negative and non-numeric values are rejected or corrected to 1. Very large values are capped or refused with a message. Record actual behaviour; anything accepted below 1 is a defect.
Actual result: Quantity 1 and 999 accepted correctly. 0 added a line with total Rs. 0; -1 added a line with total Rs. -500; 1000000 accepted (total Rs. 500,000,000); "abc" leaves the field empty and adds nothing.

Title: Remove a product from the cart
Steps:
1. Open the cart.
2. Click the "X" next to one product.
Expected result: That line disappears without a page reload; the other product remains.
Actual result: Line removed without reload; other product remains.

Title: Empty cart message
Steps: 1. Remove the last product.
Expected result: "Cart is empty! Click here to buy products." with a link back to Products.
Actual result: "Cart is empty! Click here to buy products." with link to Products.

Title: Guest cart is kept after logging in
Steps:
1. As a guest search "top" and add every result to the cart.
2. Log in.
3. Open the cart.
Expected result: All products added as a guest are still in the cart.
Actual result: 14 products added as guest; all 14 still in cart after login.

Title: Guest is asked to register or log in at checkout
Steps: 1. Open the cart and click "Proceed To Checkout".
Expected result: A "Checkout" modal says "Register / Login account to proceed on checkout." with a link to the login page.
Actual result: Checkout modal with "Register / Login account to proceed on checkout." and login link.

Title: Delivery and billing address match the account details
Steps:
1. Proceed to checkout.
2. Compare "Your delivery address" and "Your billing address" with the details entered at signup.
Expected result: Both addresses show the same title, name, company, address lines, city, state, zipcode, country and phone.
Actual result: Delivery and billing address both match the signup details.

Title: Review order totals before paying
Preconditions: Logged in, two products in cart.
Steps:
1. Proceed to checkout.
2. Check "Review Your Order".
Expected result: Same products, quantities and totals as the cart; the total amount is the sum of the lines.
Actual result: Review lists 2 products; lines sum to Rs. 900, matching the total.

Title: Pay with complete card details
Test data: Name on card, card number 4111 1111 1111 1111, CVC 123, expiry 12/2030
Steps:
1. Add a comment, click "Place Order".
2. Fill all payment fields.
3. Click "Pay and Confirm Order".
Expected result: "ORDER PLACED!" and "Congratulations! Your order has been confirmed!" are shown.
Actual result: "ORDER PLACED!" and "Congratulations! Your order has been confirmed!" shown.

Title: Payment form enforces mandatory fields
Steps: 1. Leave one payment field empty and click "Pay and Confirm Order".
Expected result: Order is not placed while any field is empty.
Actual result: Order not placed while any of the 5 payment fields was empty.

Title: Payment rejects malformed or expired cards
Steps:
1. Enter each invalid value with the other fields valid.
2. Click "Pay and Confirm Order".
Expected result: Order is refused with a clear message. On a demo site this may be accepted; if so, raise it as a risk for any real payment integration.
Actual result: Order placed with card number "abcd", with CVC "1" and with expiry 01/2020. No client-side card validation. Raised as a risk for a real payment integration.

Title: Download the invoice after ordering
Steps:
1. Click "Download Invoice".
2. Open the downloaded file.
Expected result: A file is downloaded and states the customer name and the total amount of the order.
Actual result: Downloaded invoice.txt: "Hi Priya Shah, Your total purchase amount is 500. Thank you"

Title: Cart is emptied after a successful order
Steps: 1. Click "Continue", then open the cart.
Expected result: Cart is empty.
Actual result: Cart empty after the order.

Title: Contact form with a file attachment
Test data: Name, email, subject, message, small .txt file
Steps:
1. Click "Contact us".
2. Fill every field and choose a file.
3. Click "Submit" and accept the browser confirmation.
Expected result: "Success! Your details have been submitted successfully." "Home" returns to the home page.
Actual result: Success message shown; Home returned to the home page.

Title: Contact form requires a valid email
Steps: 1. Fill the form without a valid email and submit.
Expected result: Form is not submitted; email field flagged.
Actual result: Not submitted with empty or invalid email.

Title: Subscribe from the home page footer
Steps: 1. Scroll to the footer, enter an email under "SUBSCRIPTION", click the arrow.
Expected result: "You have been successfully subscribed!" is shown.
Actual result: "You have been successfully subscribed!" shown.

Title: Subscribe from the cart page footer
Steps: 1. Open the cart, subscribe from the footer.
Expected result: Same success message as UI-MISC-03.
Actual result: Same success message from the cart page.

Title: Subscription rejects an invalid email
Steps: 1. Enter the invalid email and click the arrow.
Expected result: No success message; the field is flagged.
Actual result: No success message; field flagged invalid.

Title: Header navigation reaches every main page
Steps: 1. Click each header link: Home, Products, Cart, Signup / Login, Test Cases, API Testing, Contact us.
Expected result: Each link opens the right page with its heading; no broken links.
Actual result: All 7 header links open the right page.

Title: Scroll-up arrow returns to the top
Steps:
1. Scroll to the bottom of the home page.
2. Click the arrow in the bottom-right corner.
Expected result: Page scrolls to the top and the banner text "Full-Fledged practice website for Automation Engineers" is visible.
Actual result: Scrolled back to the top; banner text visible.

Title: Cross-browser smoke test
Preconditions: Latest Chrome, Firefox, Edge and Safari.
Steps: 1. Run UI-AUTH-05, UI-PROD-03, UI-CART-01 and UI-CHK-04 in each browser.
Expected result: Same behaviour and no layout breakage in every browser.
Actual result: Only Chromium is available on this machine; Firefox, Edge and Safari runs not possible in this cycle.

Title: Usable on a mobile screen
Steps: 1. Open home, products, cart and checkout pages.
Expected result: Navigation collapses into a menu; no horizontal scrolling; buttons are large enough to tap.
Actual result: No horizontal scrolling at 375 × 812, but the header never collapses: 8 menu links wrap over three rows above the content. Usable, not the expected collapsed menu.

Title: Login and signup with the keyboard only
Steps: 1. Use Tab, Shift+Tab and Enter only to fill and submit the login form.
Expected result: Every field and button is reachable in a logical order with a visible focus indicator.
Actual result: Tab order email → password → Login; Enter logs in. Focus is shown by the button changing from orange to grey (no outline).

Title: Automated accessibility scan
Steps: 1. Run the scan on each page.
Expected result: No critical WCAG 2.1 AA violations. Record score and issues.
Actual result: /: 3 violations (1 critical: button-name); /product_details/1: 3 violations (2 critical: button-name, label); /login: 2 violations (1 critical: button-name). button-name: icon-only buttons (e.g. the subscribe arrow) have no accessible name; label: form field without a label on the product page.

Title: Page load time
Preconditions: DevTools Network tab, cache disabled, no throttling.
Steps: 1. Load home, products and a product detail page three times each.
Expected result: DOMContentLoaded under 3 s on average. This is a sanity check, not a load test.
Actual result: Average DOMContentLoaded (ads blocked): / 1524 ms, /products 2069 ms, /product_details/1 759 ms.

Title: Site is served over HTTPS
Steps: 1. Open the http:// address.
Expected result: Browser is redirected to https:// and shows a valid certificate.
Actual result: Redirected to https://automationexercise.com/

Title: New customer: register at checkout, pay, download invoice, delete account
Requirement: REQ-01, REQ-03, REQ-08, REQ-11, REQ-12, REQ-13
Steps:
1. Add two products to the cart as a guest.
2. Proceed to checkout and choose Register / Login.
3. Sign up and complete account information.
4. Return to the cart and proceed to checkout.
5. Verify address and order review, add a comment, place the order.
6. Pay with the test card.
7. Download the invoice.
8. Delete the account.
Expected result: Order confirmed, invoice downloaded with the right total, account deleted.
Actual result: Guest cart (2 items) kept through signup at checkout; address shown; order placed; invoice reads "Your total purchase amount is 900"; account deleted.

Title: Returning customer: log in, search, buy
Steps:
1. Log in.
2. Search for jeans, open one and set quantity 2.
3. Add to cart and check out.
4. Pay with the test card.
Expected result: Order confirmed; cart is empty afterwards.
Actual result: Bought 2 × "Soft Stretch Jeans"; order confirmed; cart empty afterwards.

Title: Browsing shopper: filter, compare, edit cart, then log in
Steps:
1. Filter by category and add one product.
2. Filter by brand and add one product.
3. Remove the first product from the cart.
4. Log in and open the cart.
Expected result: Only the brand product remains in the cart after login.
Actual result: Category product 1 removed; only brand product 8 remains after login.
